items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I heard him one time in the band... I told Count Basie, get up and let him play a number... People wanted to know I was going to play with that band and I would play with it before.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear him in a band? How was he in a band if he ever played in one?
Well, I heard him one time in the band. He just sitting. One night, Count Basie came down there on the gate. I think it was Count Basie. And I told Count Basie, get up and let him play a number.
I guess after Count Basie playing the front finger here, he really made the piano jump.
